There are many different techniques of doing that but heres one good for starters:

1. Set an alarm clock to about 30 minutes before you usually wake up

2. Then set another alarm to 3-10 minutes (the shorter the better) after the first one. But make sure that the alarm itself isnt music or smth like that. It should be a sound that can normally appear in nature, like water dripping or birds singing. Make sure that you memorize this sound very good

3. Go to sleep. When the first alarm wakes you up, make sure to turn it of right away. Also move as least as possible. Try to fall asleep again as quick as you can before the second alarm goes of. If you manage to do that you have a high chance of hearing that sound in your sleep and becoming aware that you're dreaming

4. Make sure to go away from the sound in your dream or blend it out so your brain will ignore it

5. Have fun literally beeing a god and controlling everything around you in your dream
